`tests/fmt_gen_1.rs`
```rust
#![allow(clippy::all, dead_code, non_snake_case, unreachable_patterns, unsafe_op_in_unsafe_fn, unused, unused_imports, unused_mut)]
use anyhow::*;
use std::string::{String, ToString};
use std::vec::Vec;
use std::boxed::Box;
use std::format;
use std::error::Error as StdError;

#[test]
fn test_display_simple() {
    let e = anyhow!("boom");
    let s = format!("{}", e);
    assert_eq!(s, "boom");
}

#[test]
fn test_display_alternate_single() {
    let e = anyhow!("single");
    let s = format!("{:#}", e);
    assert_eq!(s, "single");
}

#[test]
fn test_display_alternate_chain_two() {
    let inner = anyhow!("inner");
    let outer = inner.context("outer").unwrap_err();
    let s = format!("{:#}", outer);
    assert_eq!(s, "outer: inner");
}

#[test]
fn test_display_alternate_chain_three() {
    let e1 = anyhow!("e1");
    let e2 = e1.context("e2").unwrap_err();
    let e3 = e2.context("e3").unwrap_err();
    let s = format!("{:#}", e3);
    assert_eq!(s, "e3: e2: e1");
}

#[test]
fn test_debug_simple_no_cause() {
    let e = anyhow!("ping");
    let s = format!("{:?}", e);
    assert_eq!(s, "ping");
}

#[test]
fn test_debug_single_cause() {
    let inner = anyhow!("inner");
    let outer = inner.context("outer").unwrap_err();
    let s = format!("{:?}", outer);
    let expected = "outer\n\nCaused by:\n    inner";
    assert_eq!(s, expected);
}

#[test]
fn test_debug_multiple_causes_numbered() {
    let e1 = anyhow!("e1");
    let e2 = e1.context("e2").unwrap_err();
    let e3 = e2.context("e3").unwrap_err();
    let s = format!("{:?}", e3);
    let expected = "e3\n\nCaused by:\n     0: e2\n     1: e1";
    assert_eq!(s, expected);
}

#[test]
fn test_debug_alternate_forwards_to_inner_debug() {
    let e = anyhow!("x");
    // alternate Debug on anyhow::Error delegates to the inner error's Debug
    let s = format!("{:#?}", e);
    // The output starts with the error message
    assert!(s.starts_with("x"));
}

#[test]
fn test_debug_with_source_chain_preserves_message() {
    let io_err = std::io::Error::new(std::io::ErrorKind::Other, "io");
    let e = anyhow!(io_err);
    let s = format!("{:?}", e);
    assert!(s.starts_with("io"));
}
```
